description: This file defines the 'Language' model class within the Opencart e-commerce framework. It provides methods to fetch language records from the database by ID or code, and to retrieve all active languages, with caching support. The class extends a system engine model and interacts with database and cache components.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Model class for handling language data retrieval from the database within the Opencart system.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a language record by its primary key ID, caches the result, and constructs the image path.

methods.name: getLanguageByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a language record by its code, caches the result, and constructs the image path.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves all active language records from the database, caching results, and constructs image paths for each.
